checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No second mandatory facilities, staff or overhead fee appears; only the basic services fee is described as added.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation is offered and the list states an alternative container can be used, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description does not include the cremation itself and states the crematory charge will be a cash advance, which is consistent.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines and no other offered item lacks a price.
No optional package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
The only require-type statements are the prescribed embalming and outer burial container disclosure wording, which is never a concern.
No text claims long-term preservation or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and no required disclosure is shown in a hard-to-notice manner.
